name: office-scribe
description: Scribe: opt-in v2 scribing per session (markers, preferences, decisions) plus the v1 commanded notes and cited answers through Orbit Office.

workspace.title: Local Office workspace
workspace.description: Absolute local registered Orbit checkout on this Mac. An absolute path is an Orbit workspace selector; remote selectors are refused.

auto_capture.title: Automatic Stop/SessionEnd capture (legacy)
auto_capture.description: Off by default: /scribe is the only trigger. On, the legacy Stop and SessionEnd hooks stage transcripts and queue extraction tasks.

default_on.title: Live scribe on for new sessions (legacy)
default_on.description: With automatic capture on: whether live Stop passes start on. SessionEnd still captures when live passes are off. Excluded projects are always skipped.

excluded_projects.title: Excluded project paths
excluded_projects.description: JSON array of absolute paths. These paths and their physical descendants are never staged, scribed or captured, including by backfill.

scribe_url.title: Web Scribe screen
scribe_url.description: Address of the orbit-office app's /scribe screen (for example http://localhost:4317/scribe), linked from the desktop pane for other conversations. Empty, the default until that screen ships (ORB-20696), hides the link.
